local_expression: Shared chrome, author, post options and action toolbar are local Exact expressions of daoUI tokens and the Threads references supplied by David. Canonical type sizes/leading and scalable ink insets are retained; the post row wraps at enlarged text. Below 704px, the local compact composition uses edge-to-edge posts, full-width dividers, canonical 16px horizontal/12px vertical padding and a smaller rendering of the unchanged wordmark paths. Desktop keeps its rounded reading frame. David’s latest correction places Write at the bottom right above the full-height scroller, with clearance at the end of the scrolling content rather than a reserved action row. Its 48px mobile/64px desktop target and canonical 24px add symbol remain independent of reading-text scaling. Safe-area allowances are authored; physical-device behavior is unverified. Comment and Copy text are enabled; heart/repost/send are disabled. Forty authored root posts and twenty replies provide a finite composition specimen, without real sign-in, persistence, pagination or virtualization. Gold composer action colors retain David’s earlier approved mapping. David’s next desktop reference keeps the rounded boundary stationary during scrolling. The border and top corner radii now belong to the scroll viewport itself, with the finite posts and end clearance inside it. Mobile removes that border/radius without replacing the scroll node. A normal-browser measurement keeps the frame top at 98px through a 1400px scroll while post content moves; the floating control also retains its viewport position.
limits: No login, network requests, backend writes or live model replies
Post and per-thread drafts reset on reload
